---------1.) SYN Staging CRM_ADDRESS Preferred Address Filter
---------2.) SYN Staging SYN.STG_CCD_DCUSTOMER Test Customer Filter
---------3.) SYN Staging SYN.STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER Test Customer Filter
---------4.) FCBSCIF DimCustomer


---------1.) SYN Staging CRM_ADDRESS Preferred Address Filter
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYN.STG_CRM_ADDRESS ---3,626,386; loaded using data flow
SELECT TOP 50 * FROM SYN.STG_CRM_ADDRESS
SELECT ORGKEY, COUNT(*) FROM SYN.STG_CRM_ADDRESS GROUP BY ORGKEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 --- 4 CIFs with duplicates (for checking w/ source); R01351586, P00003239, R01444086, R01212461
---Checking of filters
SELECT END_DATE, COUNT(*) FROM SYN.STG_CRM_ADDRESS GROUP BY END_DATE --- all '2099-12-31'
SELECT PREFERREDADDRESS, COUNT(*) FROM SYN.STG_CRM_ADDRESS GROUP BY PREFERREDADDRESS --- all 'Y'
--Record count validation
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM busc.CRM_ADDRESS WHERE PREFERREDADDRESS = 'Y' AND END_DATE = '2099-12-31' AND (ORGKEY LIKE 'R%' OR ORGKEY LIKE 'P%') AND ACCOUNTID != 0 --- 3,475,159 records
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM busc.CRM_ADDRESS WHERE PREFERREDADDRESS = 'Y' AND END_DATE = '2099-12-31' AND (ORGKEY LIKE 'C%' OR ORGKEY LIKE 'B%') AND CORP_ID != 0 --- 151,227 records
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
    (SELECT * FROM busc.CRM_ADDRESS WHERE PREFERREDADDRESS = 'Y' AND END_DATE = '2099-12-31' AND (ORGKEY LIKE 'R%' OR ORGKEY LIKE 'P%') AND ACCOUNTID != 0 UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM busc.CRM_ADDRESS WHERE PREFERREDADDRESS = 'Y' AND END_DATE = '2099-12-31' AND (ORGKEY LIKE 'C%' OR ORGKEY LIKE 'B%') AND CORP_ID != 0) A
---3,626,386 records; matches the records loaded to SYN Staging using data flow


---------2.) SYN Staging SYN.STG_CCD_DCUSTOMER Test Customer Filter
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYN.STG_CCD_DCUSTOMER --- 366 records; loaded using data flow
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM busc.CCD_DCUSTOMER --- 366 records
SELECT TOP 50 * FROM SYN.STG_CCD_DCUSTOMER

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYN.STG_CCD_DCUSTOMER WHERE --- 366 records
    CUST_LOCAL_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    OR CUST_FIRST_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    OR CUST_MIDDLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    OR CUST_LAST_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
WITH A AS (
    SELECT * FROM SYN.STG_CCD_DCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACCP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR WHERE B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR IS NOT NULL
    )
    , B AS (
    SELECT * FROM SYN.STG_CCD_DCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACCP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR WHERE B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR IS NULL
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM A WHERE (CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TES%' OR CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TST%' OR CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'XXX%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM busc.CCD_DCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACCP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
    WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TES%' OR B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TST%' OR B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'XXX%' --- 185
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM busc.CCD_DCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACCP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
    WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE IS NULL --- 183
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM busc.CCD_DCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACCP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
    WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE IS NOT NULL --- 185

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.CUST_NBR)) FROM busc.CCD_DCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACCP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
    WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE IS NULL --- 183
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.CUST_NBR)) FROM busc.CCD_DCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACCP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
    WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE IS NOT NULL --- 183

SELECT A.CUST_NBR, COUNT(*) FROM busc.CCD_DCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACCP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
    WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE IS NOT NULL --- 183
    GROUP BY A.CUST_NBR HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT * FROM busc.CCD_CBCEXCACCP WHERE CRDACCT_CUST_NBR IN ('000000000010077', '000000000024581')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.CUST_NBR)) FROM busc.CCD_DCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACCP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
    WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TES%' OR B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TST%' OR B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'XXX%' --- 183
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.CUST_NBR)) FROM busc.CCD_DCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACCP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
    WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE IS NULL --- 183


---------3.) SYN Staging SYN.STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER Test Customer Filter
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYN.STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER --- 114,209 records; loaded using data flow
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM busc.CCD_MCUSTOMER WHERE IsLatest = 1 and IsActive = 1 --- 114641 records
SELECT TOP 50 * FROM SYN.STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYN.STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER WHERE --- 114,209 records
    CUST_LOCAL_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    OR CUST_FIRST_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    OR CUST_MIDDLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    OR CUST_LAST_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.CUST_NBR)) FROM busc.CCD_MCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACFP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
    WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TES%' OR B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TST%' OR B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'XXX%' --- 105,597
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.CUST_NBR)) FROM busc.CCD_MCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACFP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
    WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE IS NULL --- 9044
---114,641

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYN.STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER WHERE CUST_NBR IN
---SELECT COUNT(*) FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT(A.CUST_NBR) FROM busc.CCD_MCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACFP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
        WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TES%' OR B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TST%' OR B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'XXX%'
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT(A.CUST_NBR) FROM busc.CCD_MCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACFP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
        WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE IS NULL) 
        ---test
    AND (CUST_LOCAL_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    OR CUST_FIRST_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    OR CUST_MIDDLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
    OR CUST_LAST_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%')
---114,209 records; equal to what is loaded to SYN Staging

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYN.STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER WHERE --- 0 records; no Test Customer
    CUST_LOCAL_NAME LIKE '%TEST%' OR CUST_FIRST_NAME LIKE '%TEST%' OR CUST_MIDDLE_NAME LIKE '%TEST%' OR CUST_LAST_NAME LIKE '%TEST%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYN.STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACFP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR --- 33 Customers loaded in SYN with Test Accounts
    WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE LIKE 'TES%' OR B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE LIKE 'TST%' OR B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE LIKE 'XXX%'

SELECT A.CUST_NBR, B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE FROM SYN.STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACFP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
    WHERE A.CUST_NBR IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT(A.CUST_NBR) FROM SYN.STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACFP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
    WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE LIKE 'TES%' OR B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE LIKE 'TST%' OR B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE LIKE 'XXX%') ORDER BY A.CUST_NBR---B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE
---000000000051019, 000000000013746, 000000000039728, 000000000049962

SELECT A.CUST_NBR, B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE FROM busc.CCD_MCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACFP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
    WHERE A.CUST_NBR IN ('000000000051019', '000000000013746', '000000000039728', '000000000049962') ORDER BY A.CUST_NBR
---Customers have both Actual and Test Accounts
SELECT * FROM SYN.STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER WHERE CUST_NBR IN ('000000000051019', '000000000013746', '000000000039728', '000000000049962') ORDER BY CUST_NBR

--Profile extra Customers after Test Account Filter
SELECT CUST_NBR, CUST_LOCAL_NAME, CUST_FIRST_NAME, CUST_MIDDLE_NAME, CUST_LAST_NAME FROM busc.CCD_MCUSTOMER WHERE CUST_NBR IN
    (SELECT CUST_NBR FROM 
        (SELECT DISTINCT(A.CUST_NBR) FROM busc.CCD_MCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACFP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
            WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TES%' OR B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'TST%' OR B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE NOT LIKE 'XXX%'
        UNION
        SELECT DISTINCT(A.CUST_NBR) FROM busc.CCD_MCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACFP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
            WHERE B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE IS NULL) test
        WHERE CUST_NBR NOT IN (SELECT CUST_NBR FROM SYN.STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER))

---'000000000022448', '000000000003030', '000000000039663'
---'000000000043080', '000000000048383', '000000000040084', '000000000040775', '000000000047558'
SELECT * FROM SYN.STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER WHERE CUST_NBR IN ('000000000043080', '000000000048383', '000000000040084', '000000000040775', '000000000047558')
SELECT A.CUST_NBR, B.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE FROM busc.CCD_MCUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN busc.CCD_CBCEXCACFP B ON A.CUST_NBR = B.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR 
    WHERE A.CUST_NBR IN ('000000000043080', '000000000048383', '000000000040084', '000000000040775', '000000000047558')

---------4.) FCBSCIF DimCustomer
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
SELECT TOP 100 FCBSCIF, * FROM DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'
SELECT TOP 100 FCBSCIF, * FROM DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
SELECT TOP 100 FCBSCIF, * FROM DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'SEC'

SELECT CustomerId, RelatedCustomerId FROM bnkm.RelatedCustomer WHERE CustomerID IN
    ('000000000053925','000000000116588','000000000031136','000000000052678','000000000054695','000000000058050','000000000078996','000000000103090','000000000000535','000000000023384')

SELECT FCBSCIF, COUNT(*) FROM DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' GROUP BY FCBSCIF
SELECT FCBSCIF, COUNT(*) FROM DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' GROUP BY FCBSCIF ORDER BY FCBSCIF
SELECT FCBSCIF, COUNT(*) FROM DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'SEC' GROUP BY FCBSCIF

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' AND FCBSCIF IS NULL---0 -> no NULL values

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' AND FCBSCIF IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.RelatedCustomer WHERE RelatedCustomerId != ''
SELECT * FROM DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' AND FCBSCIF = '000R00010059'
SELECT CUST_NBR, CUST_CIF_NBR FROM busc.CCD_MCUSTOMER WHERE CUST_NBR = '000000000047578'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'SEC' AND FCBSCIF IS NULL---15,650 -> all NULL values

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' AND FCBSCIF IS NOT NULL

SELECT CUST_CIF_NBR, COUNT(*) FROM busc.CCD_MCUSTOMER GROUP BY CUST_CIF_NBR ORDER BY CUST_CIF_NBR
SELECT RelatedCustomerId, COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.RelatedCustomer where SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' GROUP BY RelatedCustomerId ORDER BY RelatedCustomerId
SELECT TOP 10 * FROM bnkm.RelatedCustomer WHERE RelatedCustomerId = ''

--DW.DimCustomer
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DW.DimCustomer A LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement B ON A.CustomerID = B.CustomerID
    WHERE A.FCBSCIF != B.FCBSCIF
SELECT TOP 50 A.CustomerID, A.CustomerSK, B.CustomerID, B.CustomerSK FROM DW.DimCustomer A LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer_bu_20230811 B ON A.CustomerID = B.CustomerID

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
SELECT TOP 100 FCBSCIF, * FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'
SELECT TOP 100 FCBSCIF, * FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
SELECT TOP 100 FCBSCIF, * FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'SEC'

SELECT CustomerId, FCBSCIF FROM dw.DimCustomer WHERE CustomerID IN
    ('000000000053925','000000000116588','000000000031136','000000000052678','000000000054695','000000000058050','000000000078996','000000000103090','000000000000535','000000000023384')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' AND FCBSCIF IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' AND FCBSCIF IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DW.DimCustomer_Enhancement WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'SEC' AND FCBSCIF IS NULL
